text: Feature Request pls: 1-Click Google Calendar Sync 📅 Review: This is an incredible habit tracker with a fantastic design! To make it perfect, please add a 1-click Google Calendar synchronization button. Many of us manage our entire day through Google Calendar. Being able to instantly sync our habits would save time and vastly improve our daily workflow. Please consider this for the next update. Keep up the amazing work!
author: Imran Said
